title: Could the Mall World be the "Talk on the hill" for non-divergent people? Have you heard of the Telepathy Tapes?

classification.theory_summary: Speculates whether recurring 'Mall World' experiences could relate to a purported telepathic meeting place ('The Hill') described in the 'Telepathy Tapes' podcast about non-verbal autistic children.
classification.question_topic: Whether Mall World could be analogous to 'The Hill' (a 'space/non space' where people 'meet each other') described in Telepathy Tapes; asks community opinions.
classification.skip_reason: No first-person dream narrative or concrete phenomenological description of a Mall World dream; only references an external concept ('The Hill') in a speculative question.

meta.author_theory: Asks whether non-divergent people might have an unconscious capability that manifests as 'Mall World', analogous to a reported telepathic meeting place called 'The Hill' (a 'space/non space') from the 'Telepathy Tapes' podcast.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains no described dream locations/events. Only phenomenological-like phrases are quoted secondhand about 'The Hill' as a 'space/non space' where kids 'meet each other', but not presented as the author's dream experience and not enough detail to model as Mall World locations/connections.
